h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sikar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sikar

items.pText: In Sikar, the wind carries fine sand for much of the dry season, and it settles in every joint, bearing and slide bed on an open play area. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, coaching campuses, colonies and gardens in Sikar at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 940 km away, and sends it by road.

The city is part of the Shekhawati region of Rajasthan, known for its painted havelis and, in recent years, for its many schools and coaching institutes. Summers are very hot and winter nights are cold. Send us the size of your site, the age group and a few photos. We will suggest equipment that copes with sand and heat and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Keeping sand out of the moving parts

c: Sand is hardest on parts that move. Swing hooks, spring riders, merry-go-round bearings and see-saw pivots wear faster when grit gets in. Sweep or blow sand off the equipment every week in the dry months, and wipe the moving parts clean before the summer holidays end.

items.q: How do we look after playground equipment in a sandy area?
items.a: Sweep sand off every week in the dry season, keep moving parts such as hooks, springs and bearings clean, and check them more often than you would in a less dusty town.

items.q: Which equipment needs the least maintenance?
items.a: Fixed pieces without moving parts, such as climbers and slides. Swings, spring riders and merry-go-rounds are popular but need more regular checks.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Sikar?
items.a: Yes. We send it by road from our Vasai factory and install it through our own team or a dealer in north India.
